Method of Attack: Web shell allowing attackers to execute Microsoft .NET code using HTTP POST commands to upload and download files, execute programs, list directory contents, and access Active Directory
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Microsoft Exchange Server zero-day vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-26855, CVE-2021-26857, CVE-2021-26858, CVE-2021-27065)
Indicators of Compromise: Web shells deployed on compromised Exchange servers
PowerShell and console commands to scan Event Logs/Exchange Server logs
Nmap script by Kevin Beaumont to scan for vulnerable Exchange servers
